name: An'she's Guidance raises Holy crit chance and cuts spell pushback (#1303)
contract: An'she's Guidance rank 1 (681064) and rank 2 (681470) are both SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE (auto-applied on learn). Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE_SCHOOL (71) with EffectMiscValue school mask 2 (Holy) and EffectBasePoints 1/3 resolving to +2/+4 with DieSides 1; AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct-adjacent generic handling (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) folds this into Player::UpdateAllSpellCritChances, a native, family-agnostic stat aura with no script needed. Effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK (149) with EffectBasePoints 49/99 resolving to +50/+100; Spell::Delayed (Spell.cpp, two call sites) reads delayReduce = 100 + caster->GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK) - 100, so amount 100 (rank 2) makes delayReduce reach 100 and pushback is skipped entirely, matching the tooltip's 100%. Effect 1 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, SPELLMOD_THREAT) resolves to 0 (EffectBasePoints -1, DieSides 1) on both ranks and does nothing; only the two effects the tooltip describes carry a nonzero value.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1 raises Holy spell crit chance by 2
Rank 2 raises Holy spell crit chance by 4
Rank 1's own crit-chance effect amount is 2
Rank 1's own pushback-reduction effect amount is 50
Rank 2's own crit-chance effect amount is 4
Rank 2's own pushback-reduction effect amount is 100
